entities.name: Ołeksandr Feldman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olexandr Borysovych Feldman is a Ukrainian politician and public figure, People's Deputy of Ukraine, businessman, multi-millionaire. He is considered to be one of the most influential people in Kharkiv. In 2013 he entered the rating of the hundred richest Ukrainians of the Ukrainian magazine Forbes, finishing 35th. Since June 2015, the co-chairman of the political party Our Land.
